description: Data-backed email marketing skill for AI agents. Use when building or running email automation, driving an ESP from an agent (MCP/connectors), diagnosing deliverability, writing or de-slopping email copy, directing AI email design, choosing a platform, or pulling benchmarks. Covers flows, segmentation, compliance, cold email, WhatsApp, SMS and RCS, and 19 industry playbooks.
